user.title: Marantz / Denon receiver
user.description: Enter the IP address of the receiver. Set Network Control to Always On on the receiver, and close any other app that uses its telnet port: it only accepts one connection at a time.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect, or the receiver did not answer. Check the address, that Network Control is Always On, and that nothing else is connected to port 23.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send one or more raw telnet commands to the receiver, for example MVUP, SITV or PSDYNEQ ON.

command.name: Command
command.description: Raw command (or list of commands), without the trailing carriage return.

config_entry_id.name: Receiver
config_entry_id.description: Only send to this receiver (defaults to all).
